messages.en: Wav!!! Thank you so, so, so much, seriously.

messages.ko: 단체 엔딩도 시켜주고 1위도 시켜주고 진짜 너무너무 고마워 항상 나에게 과분한 사랑주는것같아서 진짜 감사해…
messages.en: You gave us the group ending and you gave us 1st place too. Thank you so much. I always feel like you're giving me more love than I deserve... I'm really grateful.

messages.ko: 응원법도 우렁차게 해주는 웨이브들 보면서도 맘이 뭉클하더라 정말 사랑해!!!
messages.en: Watching Wav cheer so loudly with the fan chants made me emotional too. I really love you!!!
My mom called to congratulate me on getting 1st place.
She told me to treat Wav well.
I should do better.
I kept looking at Wav while performing on stage.
Even during the group ending.
Are all your throats okay?
The one thing I regret is...
I told myself I was going to absolutely nail the encore live.
But I got nervous about the high note.
So I kind of messed it up.
I'm sorry...
If I ever get another chance,
I'll show you.
Maybe I shouldn't say things like that.
What if I mess up again?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
But you know...
I really love you.
I especially felt it today.

messages.ko: 무대에 있는 내 시선이 추억이 됐을때 진짜 이쁜 추억이겠다 정말 소중하겠다 싶었어
messages.en: When I thought about how the view from my eyes on stage would become a memory someday, I thought it would be such a beautiful and precious memory.
So I tried to take it all in.

messages.ko: 몇년이고 추억으로 남기보단 계속 함께했으면 좋겠다
messages.en: But rather than keeping it as a memory years later, I hope we can just keep being together.
I'll do my best until the end.

messages.ko: 요즘 바쁘지만 요상하게 안아프고 쌩쌩한것같아 나는
messages.en: I've been busy lately, but strangely I don't feel sick at all. I feel energetic.

messages.ko: 이 바쁨을 즐기라고 몸이 신호를 받는느낌
messages.en: It's like my body is telling me to enjoy being this busy.
Maybe it's because I've been taking vitamins...
You should take albumin supplements too.
And deer antler extract.
"My heart is 녹용."
"My heart is deer antler extract?"
Ah, that overlaps...
Please stop making the joke before I do.
It makes it look like I'm copying you~
Jeong Hayeon, you type slowly, don't you?
I'll come back after taking my nails off. ;;

messages.ko: 하연아 뒷말 따라하면서 ㅎ붙이면 설레는거 알아? ex)때고올거야?ㅎ
messages.en: Hayeon, do you know it's heart-fluttering when you repeat the end of a sentence and add 'ㅎ'? Like, 'You'll come back after taking them off?ㅎ'
Isn't that kind of cheesy?
That makes your heart flutter?ㅎ
Don't you miss me?ㅎ
Do you want to hear me say I miss you?ㅎ
Hurry and tell me you miss me.
I miss you so much.
..You're not being sarcastic, are you?
It does kind of sound like that. ㅋㅅㅋㅅㅋㅎㅋㅎㅎㅋㅋㄹㅋㅎ
Like, 'Oh, so this is what you like?ㅎ'
That kind of feeling.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎ
You're really a fascinating person. ㅎ
You're really unique! ㅎㅎ
That's more like it.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹ
I'm going to scrub my makeup off.
I'll be back after taking it off.
Wait for me. ㅎ
Actually, if I wash up now...
I feel like I'll end up taking a full shower.
So I'll chat a little longer before I go.
...I'm kind of touched that I'm more important than your shower.
It's not just the shower.
I'd even give up my skincare and sleep right now...
Because Y/n is more important, right?ㅎ
Let me tell you a little behind-the-scenes story.

messages.ko: 오늘 미간에 붙은 반짝반짝 이쁜 스티커들은
messages.en: Those sparkly stickers between my eyebrows today...
Were actually my attempt to cover up a giant pimple!!!!
Ah...
Wait... I probably shouldn't have said that.
No, seriously, I got a huge one.
It really hurts.
Even magical girls get giant pimples??
Magical girl pimples come out in the shape of stars.
That's kind of gross.
Let's talk about something else.
Did you see Haseok stop by for a bit today?
He came to Show Champion to cheer me on.
But lately...
Even when I do strong makeup...
I'm still just a circle!!!!!!
But I haven't gained any weight.
What could it be?
I wasn't this round before.
Why is this happening?
My face shape keeps changing.
Even my nose shape changed again.
I don't know. Maybe I'm basically Beauty Inside.
That's it.
You mean *The Beauty Inside*.
Yeah... that.
I didn't get anything done though.
Please bring back the sharp fox-cat look...
I want to do it too!!!!
My friends keep messaging me.

messages.ko: 너 뭐 했지 너 어디 만졌지
messages.en: "What did you get done? What did you change?"
They keep asking that.
And when I tell them I didn't...
"Just tell us already!!!!"
That's what they say.
My number one haters. ❤️❤️
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
Only real friends can get away with saying that. 😂
Exactly. ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅎㅋㅋ
y/n.
If anyone makes you cry, tell me.
I won't let them get away with it.
You're the one who always makes me cry...
I guess that's my fault.

messages.ko: 너는 뭔가 혼내주기보다 그냥 같이 혼나고 울어줄거같은데 ..
messages.en: You seem like the type who wouldn't scold someone, but would just get scolded together with me and cry...
Then I'll cry for you instead.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅎㅋㄹㅎㅋ
Wow, does that mean I'll get to see Hayeon cry? 😳
But the more you keep saying you're curious about seeing me cry...
The more stubborn I get, and the less I want to cry.
Do you really want to make me cry that badly????
I'll prove that I can never cry!!!!
If Binnie cries, then you have to cry too.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
This Badge War...
Who should I make cry~?
It'd be funny if Hayeon cried during Badge War.

messages.ko: 마피아 시작하자 마자 빌런이라고 아웃되면 울수도
messages.en: If I get voted out as the villain as soon as the Mafia game starts, I might cry.
"Give me my screen time!!!! ㅠㅠㅠㅠ"
I'd be like that.

messages.ko: 프롬 구독하는 12명 전원에게 정하연 먼저 탈락시키라고 보내고 올게
messages.en: I'm going to message all 12 people subscribed to Fromm and tell them to eliminate Jeong Hayeon first.
Don't do thattt!!!!
I'm putting up a bounty. 1 million won to whoever makes Jeong Hayeon cry first.
I'll make myself cry.
I'm crying right now.
ㅠㅠㅠㅠ
Then you'll have to pay that 1 million won to all the Wav.

messages.ko: 내 첫 눈물은 웨이브에 대한 감동의 눈물로 할게
messages.en: I'll make my first tears tears of being moved by Wav.
But let me tell you a secret.
A little while ago...
I actually cried while reading Fromm once.
I was secretly reading the messages people had sent late at night.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅎㅋ

messages.ko: 내가 엄청 감성적인 얘기를 하고 갔을때였어
messages.en: It was after I'd left a really emotional message.
Kikikikikik.
You worked hard today too.
I should go wash up now.
I'll go to the music show looking pretty again tomorrow.
Sleep well.
Haranghae ❤️❤️
